prompt:
You are scoring an independent replication of a landmark genomics paper.

PAPER CLAIMS:

Stover et al. 2000 "Complete genome sequence of Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1"
(Nature 406:959-964) — key quantitative/descriptive claims:
 C1. Genome size = 6,264,403 bp (single circular chromosome, ~6.26 Mbp).
 C2. G+C content = 66.6%.
 C3. Number of predicted ORFs = 5,570 protein-coding genes.
 C4. At publication, this was the largest bacterial genome sequenced to date.
 C5. Genome shows unusually high functional richness — largest number of
     regulatory proteins/two-component systems and largest fraction of
     regulatory genes among sequenced bacteria at the time.


INDEPENDENT REPLICATION RESULTS (real data pulled today):

Independent-replication (2026-07-04): RefSeq assembly GCF_000006765.1
(NC_002516.2, ASM676v1, current curated form of the Stover 2000 chromosome),
parsed with Python on genome FNA + GFF + protein FAA:

 Genome size:                   6,264,404 bp (6.264 Mbp)
 GC content:                    66.556%
 Ambiguous bases (non-ACGT):    0
 Contigs:                       1 (single circular chromosome)
 Total genes (all biotypes):    5678
 Protein-coding genes / CDS:    5573
 Unique protein_ids in GFF:     5572
 Proteins in protein.faa:       5572
 tRNA features:                 63
 rRNA features:                 13
 ncRNA features:                28
 tmRNA features:                1
 Coding fraction of genome:     89.29%
 Mean CDS length:               1003.7 bp


Additional context: C4 and C5 are historical/comparative descriptive claims
that cannot be re-derived from the FASTA/GFF alone — they were true in
year-2000 GenBank landscape and remain accurate historical statements
(no rerun needed; well-established in follow-up literature).

Task: For each claim C1-C5, judge:
 - reproduced: yes / partial / no / not-testable-from-genome
 - agreement: how closely the replication matches the paper (numeric or descriptive)
 - notes

Then give a final overall verdict from EXACTLY this vocabulary:
  REPLICATED · PARTIAL · SPOT-CHECK · NO-GO · CONTRADICTED · BLOCKED · FAILED

Respond as strict JSON with keys: claims (list of {claim,reproduced,agreement,notes}),
verdict, one_line_summary (<=200 chars).
